title: StrategyFormulationResult
description: Model-facing proposer output (OQ-03 section 4). It holds no host provenance, usage, version hash, approval, status, severity, score, treatment or finding_source. strategy is a complete strategy-artefact/1 without the API-assigned strategy_id, version and hashes. Any unresolved entry keeps the proposal as draft material: the API refuses to register it. Every reference comes from the request. Unknown fields, missing fields and wrong types make the result malformed; values are never coerced, defaulted or stripped.

SeedTranslationProposal.title: SeedTranslationProposal
SeedTranslationProposal.description: A seed translation has no parent and changes no rule. It declares every source-to-draft difference.

ControlledRevisionProposal.title: ControlledRevisionProposal
ControlledRevisionProposal.description: A controlled revision names its parent hash from the request and lists every changed leaf with its prior and new form. The list must equal the actual difference between parent and proposed definitions.

NewFamilyProposal.title: NewFamilyProposal
NewFamilyProposal.description: A new family has no parent, changes no rule and draws on the exploration budget.

ProposedStrategy.title: ProposedStrategy
ProposedStrategy.description: Strategy Contract and Strategy Definition in the strategy-artefact/1 format. The API assigns strategy_id, version and the hash, and builds the parent reference from parent_hash and rule_changes.

ProposalClaims.title: ProposalClaims
ProposalClaims.description: rationale: why the proposal should work. expected_effect: a direction of effect that evaluation can contradict; no numeric result stated as fact. invalidation_conditions: observations that would falsify it. requested_tests: tests from the policy suite or separately registered trials; they cannot alter windows, thresholds, costs, capital, data or other comparison conditions.

RequestRefs.title: RequestRefs
RequestRefs.description: Identifiers copied from the request: evidence and source IDs, or supplied method rule IDs.

UnresolvedElement.title: UnresolvedElement
UnresolvedElement.description: An element whose executable semantics are unresolved. element is a JSON Pointer into strategy; its present value is not a resolution. The proposer never fills a missing rule or substitutes an operator to reach a valid shape.
